image_description: A close-up, angled view of a black loudspeaker enclosure. The image features a large circular woofer with a metallic-looking center dust cap and rubber surround at the bottom, and a smaller driver covered by a silver mesh grille at the top. To the right, a portion of another large driver is visible. The enclosure has a glossy black finish with some reflective highlights.

While some speakers are cylindrical, the local geometry suggests a curved surface that doesn't clearly resolve into a standard box shape in this crop.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The mesh pattern on the upper driver's grille appears slightly irregular and 'mushy' in the center, lacking the perfect geometric consistency of real perforated metal or woven cloth. It looks like a generated texture approximation.

The central dust cap of the lower woofer has a faceted, almost crystalline structure rather than a smooth dome or flat disk. This geometric oddity is subtle but physically unlikely for a standard speaker component.
The curvature of the cabinet edge seems to warp slightly inconsistently with the perspective of the drivers, suggesting minor geometric instability in the enclosure's rendering.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is indeed a loudspeaker and not a similar-looking industrial fan or vent.
To check if the circular drivers are perfectly round and properly separated from the enclosure without bleeding edges.
To assess the realism of the reflections on the glossy black surface and the texture of the mesh grille.

focus_areas: Geometric regularity of the circular drivers (perfect circles vs. ovals/wobbles)
Texture consistency of the mesh grille (uniform pattern vs. melting)
Physical plausibility of the dust cap structure
Edge sharpness between the rubber surround and the enclosure
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'faceted' appearance of the lower woofer's center. Is this a stylistic choice (e.g., a specific high-end brand) or an AI artifact? Also, verify if the mesh pattern on the top driver maintains logical continuity or if it dissolves into noise.
